name: Scatterbrained
body:
School enchantment [mind-affecting]; Level bard 1, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause the target to forget what he was going to do next (i.e. his next action), leaving him dazed for one round.
